name: ChatGPT for Business (OpenAI)
pricing_tiers: ChatGPT Business: $20/user/month (teams/startups). ChatGPT Enterprise: custom pricing, no fixed seat fee. ChatGPT Team: $25/user/month (annual) or $30/user/month (monthly). ChatGPT Plus: $20/month individual. ChatGPT Pro: $200/month. Free tier also available.
free_tier_available: yes — ChatGPT Free tier with GPT-5 Turbo access (rate-limited)
latest_major_release: GPT-5 Turbo (2026); ChatGPT Business plan with Codex integration launched 2025-2026
key_capabilities: content generation, code generation/review, data analysis, customer support automation, image generation (DALL-E integration), web browsing, file analysis, multi-agent workflows, custom GPTs
integrations: 1,000+ via plugins/GPT Store; native: Microsoft 365, Google Drive, Slack, Zapier, API access; Codex IDE integrations (VS Code, JetBrains)
smb_onboarding_time: hours (self-serve signup, immediate access to web UI); enterprise: days for SSO/SCIM setup
mobile_support: iOS and Android apps with full feature parity including voice mode
estimated_smb_users: 1 million+ business users (2026 estimate); 400M+ weekly active users across all tiers
market_differentiator: most advanced general-purpose LLM (GPT-5 Turbo); broadest capability range (text, code, image, voice); largest plugin/developer ecosystem
key_competitors: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Meta AI
typical_roi_claim: 30-50% time savings on content/code tasks; Salesforce survey: 67% of SMBs report increased productivity
smb_adoption_trend: growing — 82% of SMBs have invested in AI tools (SBE Council 2026 survey); ChatGPT is most-recognized AI brand among SMBs
notable_smb_case_studies: Duolingo uses GPT-4 for language tutoring; Ironclad uses ChatGPT Enterprise for legal document automation; multiple SMB marketing agencies report 40-60% content output increase
funding_to_date: $17.9B total raised (including $6.6B Oct 2024 round at $157B valuation); $3.7B annual revenue (2025)
partner_ecosystem: Microsoft (primary investor/partner), 1,000+ GPT Store developers, enterprise reseller network via Microsoft/AWS
community_support: extensive documentation, developer forum, Discord community (1M+ members), OpenAI Academy training, API playground
